content.short: iMe Lab is a Telegram based messenger that adds wallet, DeFi, AI, and community tools for Web3 users.
content.description: iMe Lab is built as an enhanced Telegram client with wallet and Web3 features added on top of messaging. The product combines chats, multi account support, productivity tools, an integrated crypto wallet, DeFi utilities, AI features, and a discovery layer for Telegram communities and bots. In the TON ecosystem, iMe Lab matters as a social and communication app that also gives users wallet access inside a Telegram style experience, rather than acting only as a standalone finance product or a narrow payments utility.
content.meta: iMe Lab combines Telegram messaging with wallet, DeFi, AI, and community tools in one Web3 ready app on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
